status: round49 Fayyum canal management candidate; unaccepted; round48 broad fallback excluded
assessment_scale: Each dimension 0..4 supplies a nominal game assessment. The nominal sum maps to 100*sum/16; named systems carry explicit uncertainty intervals, whose shared selected quantile determines assigned development. These are inferred game mappings, not measured historical development.
source_calendar_policy: remove inherited regional calendar multiplier before applying shared management effectiveness
archetype_role: inferred analogue from source farm-system classification; not proof of historical adoption, uncertainty retained

systems.interpretation: Maintained embanked and drained fields throughout the Taihu provincial cluster. Extent is an inferred regional range, not a measured cadastral allocation.
Dedicated Angkor location approximates the archaeological catchment; maintained-area range accounts for chronology and boundary uncertainty.
Seasonal basin-water service on inherited cultivated fields in river locations; not a second crop or a whole-desert agricultural entitlement.

Medieval cooperative water control and maintained terraces on current cultivated fields. No hectare increase or additional calendar multiplier. Development and served fractions are comparable-system inferences, not source measurements. Lombok and Sasak excluded.
Dated maintained water system; same game assessment range as Bali. Cultivated extent and crop calendar unchanged; archaeological city area is not farm area.

Regional historical-system inference on existing fields, with strongest direct coverage in Malang/Brantas. Other eastern locations are explicit analogues, not independently surveyed systems. No cultivated-area or harvest-frequency increase.

Archival research establishes maintained cereal cultivation and three-field rotation in the medieval Parisis. The estate is a system analogue, not a survey of every game location. Apply the common maintained open-field assessment to existing cultivated land; do not infer hectares or attained yields from population, estate size or buildings.

Floodplain rice, fishing and seasonal grazing formed complementary livelihoods. Flood timing constrained farming. River commerce supplied Timbuktu from the more productive southern delta; this does not establish an import quantity for 1337. Treat existing northern-delta fields as mainly water-dependent, rather than assigning them almost entirely to zero-yield rainfed cultivation.

Wang Zhen's 1313 treatise describes established northern dryland farming and animal traction, combining earlier agronomy with observation. It also records the need for restoration after war. Use a maintained dryland-system analogue on Shuntian's existing fields, with the same assessment range as maintained Parisis fields. The treatise is not evidence that every recommended improvement was active locally.

rainfed_analogue_evidence.role: whole comparable-field envelope, source-normalized before recipient management

systems.interpretation: Inferred maintained mixed agriculture and coordination during post-Samalas recovery. No new cultivated hectares, irrigation, crop-calendar change or transfer of Balinese subak evidence. The 25–50 range uses the shared ordinal management scale, independent of population.

INAH regional archaeological history supports earlier lake-margin drainage and maintained cultivation. Moderate shared management assessment; no new hectares or late Mexica expansion. Water-service share remains inferred and ranges down to zero.

systems.numerical_basis: Reuse the existing maintained Egyptian hydraulic-system game range. Numbers are inferred management and operational-coverage bounds, not measurements in the historical survey. Canal and basin techniques remain distinct source mechanisms.
systems.interpretation: Gravity-fed branch and feeder canals, weirs and village water allocations support maintained agriculture in the Fayyum depression. This is not conditional on a native game river flag. Existing cultivated extent unchanged; shared hydraulic management uncertainty is inferred.
